name: Kirishima Hatsune
source:
The middle daughter of the Kirishima family. Hatsune is the kind of girl who rather stays home in her room and studies. However, she may have her share of secrets as she always hides something whenever somebody enters her room.

'Stupid perverted Yuki, why are you such a siscon?'
